claim: Reports reaching Tang Wei through merchants, court reports, military dispatches, price and troop movement concern major Qin operation against northern Wei while Qin court power is divided. They now establish a further military commitment: another active military operation has been opened and an existing formation assigned to it. This is additional material action beyond the operation already reported. The reports do not by themselves establish the new operation's exact force, route, commander, supply state, combat contact, result, or immediate objective beyond the already-known campaign basis.
